Business analysis, automation, RESTful services, API creation and custom application development.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Business analysis and development.
Skills - 
Java, J2EE, JSSE, Selenium, SQL, MySQL, Tableau, Filemaker Pro Advanced, ScriptMaster(Filemaker plugin), Google Apps Script, Google Drive, XML, HTML, SOA, IntelliJ, JQuery, JSON, C++, Maven, AutoIt, Groovy, AWS (EC2, S3), BitBucket, Jira, various Apache projects and more...

positions.title: Java Developer / Blu-ray Authoring Engineer
positions.description: Create interactive Java applications for Blu-ray discs. Utilize professional authoring software(Sony Blu-Print & Scenarist BD) to create Blu-ray replication masters. Create Java automation tools to help authoring and other departments workflows. Work on high profile tent-pole Blu-ray discs for most major studios. Research and development on emerging technologies such as, Common File Format(CFF) and Ultra High Definition(UHD) Blu-ray. Mentor QA staff  and junior team members.

positions.title: Vice President of Technical Services
positions.description: Built a Quality Assurance company from the ground up with a primary focus on DVD emulation and check disc QA. Ran day-to-day technical operations. Created all technical documentation and testing requirements. Received feedback from clients, to streamline internal processes.
